## About
We are a family owned business, and our home is the San Fernando Valley. We're a full service body shop, here to give our friends and neighbors the best repair we can.
As carmakers started using new and exotic materials, we sent our body men to the right schools to learn how to repair them, and we keep training as new materials come along. We have also changed how the shop runs to cut our carbon footprint, from our heated downdraft paint booths to the water clarifier system.
One reviewer called us a family shop run by a father and his sons, and Armen, the owner, is named in our reviews. To us, the trust you show when you leave your car and ask us to fix it is the thing that matters most.

## Services
- Bumper repair: We check your bumper for dents, cracks and scratches, then pick the right fix, from dent removal to repainting. Plastic bumpers can often be repaired depending on the damage.
- Aluminum repair: Aluminum needs different tools and know-how than steel. Our technicians have the training to repair it properly.
- Paint repair: We paint in heated down draft paint booths, built for the finish that today's low VOC paints need.

## FAQ
Q: Is the estimate free?
A: Yes. Give us a call to set an appointment for your free estimate.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. Email us a picture of the damaged area with your name and your vehicle's make and model, and we'll email you our estimate.

Q: What if my car needs a tow?
A: Our preferred tow service is Sebo towing, and they're available around the clock, every day of the week.
